open_risks: Live composition: TorrentEngine exposes neither the lifecycle surface (torrent view, committed bitfield, per-piece commit notification, buffer, store dest, whole-file select) nor several statistics fields (name, per-wire records, unique, connectionTries, swarmConnections, selections, piece geometry), nor a swarm pause. These are itemized in WIRING-REQUEST.json; nothing is zero-filled.
EngineRegistry::list() is sorted; creation order needs EngineEvents forwarded to RegistryEngineCatalog::observe().
User fileMustInclude patterns run on std::regex ECMAScript: JS-only constructs are treated as invalid, 'm' is a no-op, and regex-engine exhaustion counts as no match instead of M80's 500 ms timeout.
Through RegistryEngineCatalog a second removal during a pending destroy is a no-op (K11 erases at once); the source destroys twice.
K00 jsonStringify is not JSON.stringify for non-integral numbers; K12 uses its own serializer and does not change K00.
